spans.s: शाखाङ्ग n. limb of the body.
शाखान्तग a. having finished one Śākhā ((r.)).
शाखाबाहु m. an arm (-like) branch.
शाखाभेद m. pl. divisions and subdivisions.
शाखामय (f. ई*) consisting of branches.
शाखामृग m. ape (branch-animal).

शाखि॑न् a. having branches or schools (Veda);
 m. tree.
शाखीय a. belonging to the school of (—˚).

सखड्ग^1 a. (armed) with a sword.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: Sword is Kaqga.
स॑खि m. friend, comrade, attendant.
सखी f. female friend or companion.

सखिता f. सखि˚त्व॑ & सखि˚त्वन॑ n. friendship,
fellowship, intimacy.
सखिपूर्व n. ˚भाव m. = prec.
स॑खिवन्त् a. having followers.
सखिवि॑द् a. winning friends.
सखीगण m. (number of female) friends.
सखीजन a. female friend, confidante (also coll.).
सखीस्नेह m. love for a (female) friend.*
सखीय् only ˚य॑न्त् desirous of friendship.
सखेदम् adv. sorrowfully.
सख्य॑ n. friendship, fellowship, relationship.

साख्य॑ n. association, party;
 friendship, affection.
